desktop.text: Desktop pages (fluid: they reflow to tablet and phone)

stack.text:
Build stack for the real app:
• Tailwind CSS v4 + shadcn/ui (Button, Card, Tabs, Accordion, Drawer, Badge, Tooltip)
• Motion (motion.dev) for entrances, layout and shared-element transitions
• KaTeX for math
• Vaul drawer for step explanations on phones
• prefers-reduced-motion respected everywhere

Theme: Akelius DNA, modern execution.
• Akelius tokens as Tailwind theme colors: navy #172b53 (primary, text), pale blue #d0efff (selected), blue #357ca2 (links), yellow #ffe923 (highlight), green #00a57c / #007a5c for text (checked), ground #f6f7f9
• Figtree headings, Inter body, lowercase labels like Akelius
• Akelius lesson conventions: balance scale, operation shown in green on both sides
